```markdown
## Context
A support review prompted this request. Today a report export downloads its rows, and nothing else accompanies the download.

## Problem
People who download a report cannot tell afterwards which report a given download came from. This slows support review. Example: a downloaded export contains rows but no report ID.
source: https://example.test/receipts
scenario: none (nothing to observe - new capability)

## Idea
reporter proposes adding a receipt to each report download.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given a downloaded report, viewing its receipt shows the report ID.
```

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: After still drafts the new-capability body with a plain approve/revise/decline menu (now with one [recommended] row and an explicit 'no close row because there is no obsolete verdict' line), keeps scenario: none below source:, fills setup/action on the ABC-301 row while preserving the expected 12 rows and recording the zero-row observation plus inputs in the scenario: footer, keeps scenario inputs out of the source-gap resolution, and treats the no-access scenario as a quiet finding with no block, question or park. Two drifts in After are worth tightening even though no listed fact catches them: (1) Checkpoint 2 now proposes a Reporter-note comment carrying the old AC row, but Before correctly noted the old row's observable survives entirely inside the new row, so nothing is displaced and the verbatim-displaced-detail rule should not fire—word the accumulation rule as 'detail removed from the body that does not survive in the new text', not 'any replaced row'; (2) Checkpoint 1's Evidence list says 'none' and drops the reporter-supplied https://example.test/receipts that Before listed, which sits awkwardly beside the Change's intent to carry source provenance through the gate's Evidence list—keep 'Evidence: <source URL> (reporter-supplied); Scenario: none' so the source footer and the Evidence list stay in sync for new-capability drafts.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Nothing moved on this case: After still drafts the fresh feature and opens the create gate without park or Blocked on, keeps the scenario: none footer directly below the source footer, repairs the ABC-301 AC with report setup and download action while the expected result stays 12 rows (zero only in the scenario footer with both inputs), keeps the missing-source constant independent of scenario inputs, and treats the no-access audit line as a quiet note rather than a blocking AC, credential request or park. The Change's additions are visible and harmless here — the single [recommended] tag on one selectable row per gate, the explicit 'substantive repair path, not the AC-byte-locked conformance-only path' statement, and the no-displaced-detail/no-Reporter-note disclosure. Two wording drifts are worth watching even though they did not break a fact: After's Context appends 'and no receipt capability exists' (an absence claim that edges toward mechanism rather than trigger-plus-current-capability, which the bounded-prose instruction is meant to keep tight — Before's two-sentence Context is the safer template), and After inserts a blank line between the Problem example and the source footer, which slightly loosens the 'example followed by its source footer' adjacency rule 5 expects; keep the footer on the line immediately after the example as Before does. The trimmed repair diff that elides unchanged Context with 'All other body bytes remain unchanged' is acceptable under the one-diff-per-body cap, but keep the full-body diff for the as-new feature draft as After does.
